title: Erdős Problem #1157: General Extremal Numbers for r-Uniform Hypergraphs
description: Determine the extremal number ex_r(n, F) where F is the family of all r-uniform

overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1157 concerns general extremal numbers for r-uniform hypergraphs. This problem remains OPEN.

Known results include: - Brown-Erdős-Sós (1973): Lower bound ex_r(n, F) ≫ n^{(rs-k)/(s-1)} for k > r, s > 1 - The case r = s = 3, k = 6 is Problem #716 (Ruzsa-Szemerédi theorem) - The case r = 3, k = s + 2 is Problem #1076 (solved by Bohman-Warnke 2019) - The case t = 2 is Problem #1178

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1157.
